tasks.subject: Introduce native subtree plan and fragment renderer skeleton
tasks.description: Implement Phase 2 by replacing the aggregation-specific native execution node with a general nativeSubtreePlan that executes rendered native fragments. Keep the initial supported subset narrow: selectors, scalar literals as source constants, unary arithmetic, scalar/vector arithmetic, and simple aggregations.
tasks.activeForm: Introducing native subtree plan and renderer

tasks.subject: Route simple native aggregation through fragment builder
tasks.description: Build a fragment-builder layer in internal/promshim/native that lowers the currently supported subset into an internal fragment IR and renders SQL separately. Re-express the current native aggregation pushdown as a special case of the new general native subtree mechanism without changing supported query shapes.
tasks.activeForm: Routing simple native aggregation through fragment builder

tasks.subject: Adapt native plan explain and tests for subtree execution
tasks.description: Update explain output and native-plan tests to validate native subtree selection and SQL rendering under the Phase 2 architecture. Add renderer-focused tests or snapshots for the narrow supported subset.
tasks.activeForm: Adapting explain and tests for subtree execution
